'''Guanlos Mez''' was a [[Clarodian]] [[Gender|male]] who supervised a deep-mantle [[Mez mining operation|mining operation]] with his older sibling, [[Tianris Mez]], on the [[planet]] [[Ueda]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. Although Tianris wished to retire, he did not think Guanlos was ready for the responsibility. In [[132 BBY]], the two visited the [[Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop]] in [[Point Ueda]] on Ueda and were present when the [[Sith assassin]] [[Mae-ho Aniseya]] [[Mae's quest|entered]] to [[Indara's murder|kill]] [[Jedi Master]] [[Indara]].

==Biography==
Guanlos Mez was a [[Clarodian]] [[Gender|male]] who worked as a [[miner]] on the [[planet]] [[Ueda]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. He helped jointly supervise an old family deep-mantle [[mining]] [[Mez mining operation|operation]] in the [[Eastern Wilderness]] with his older sibling, [[Tianris Mez]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> By [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> Tianris was looking to retire, but he did not think Guanlos was capable of handling the responsibility it would leave him and so often asked for advice and wisdom from [[Jedi Master]] [[Indara]], with whom Guanlos was also acquainted.<ref name="AcolyteVG" />

[[File:GuanlosMez-LostFound.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=A hooded Mae-ho Aniseya enters the crowded Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop, with Guanlos Mez stood to the left of the bar with a pair of humans. Tianris Mez sits at the end of a table in the back corner.|Guanlos Mez (center) and his brother Tianris (far left) visited the Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop.]]
In 132 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the two visited<ref name="LostFound">{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}}</ref> the [[Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop]] in [[Point Ueda]], the [[capital]] [[city]] of Ueda.<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> When the [[Sith assassin]] [[Mae-ho Aniseya]] arrived at the establishment [[Mae's quest|seeking]] Indara, Tiarnris was sat at a table with Indara and several<ref name="LostFound" /> other locals,<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> while Guanlos stood at the bar with a pair of [[human]]s. The younger brother then moved elsewhere before Aniseya confronted Indara and attacked her dining companions,<ref name="LostFound" /> knocking out Tianris<ref name="LostFoundAD">{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> and eventually [[Indara's murder|killing]] the [[Jedi]].<ref name="LostFound" />

==Personality and traits==
Guanlos Mez enjoyed crude jokes and found it novel that Indara also engaged in colorful banter. His sibling did not believe he was ready for the responsibility of managing their mining operation on his own. Guanlos had [[Color|black]] [[eye]]s and skin that was shades of green, purple, red, and tan.<ref name="AcolyteVG" />

==Equipment==
While at the [[noodle]] shop, Guanlos wore brown [[Clothing|pants]], a brown shirt, a brown [[belt]], and a gray [[scarf]] and [[Limb|wrist]] wraps under a brown dust-repelling [[Cloak|shroud]] designed for mine work.<ref name="AcolyteVG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Guanlos Mez first appeared in "[[Lost / Found]],"<ref name="LostFound" /> the first episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which aired on [[Disney+]] on [[June 4]], [[2024]].<ref name="Announcement">{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}}</ref> The scenes in the shop were filmed at [[Shinfield Studios]],<ref name="Fantha Part I">{{WebCite|url=https://www.fanthatracks.com/news/the-acolyte-a-journey-to-the-filming-locations-part-1-madeira|text=The Acolyte: A journey to the filming locations Part 1: Madeira|archivedate=20241204220147}}</ref> [[Wikipedia:England|England]].<ref name="Julian Foddy">{{Lucasfilm|url=news/julian-foddy-acolyte|text=''The Acolyte'' Visual Effects Supervisor Julian Foddy}}</ref> He was first identified in the [[2025]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" />
